title: 874 History of Morris Gershekovitch, British

page_data.en:
Foreign Affairs Sect.
21-12-44
636
Re History of Morris Gershkovitch, British.
Date 3-1-45
Name. Morris Gershkovitch
Nationality. British subject (Russian parentage)
Former Address. Police Headquarters, 185 Foochow Road.
Passport. British Passport No. 7694 issued by the British
Authorities in Singapore.
Russian Emigrants Certificate No. 14957 issued by
the Shanghai Russian Emigrants Committee.
Occupation. Shipping Clerk, Reporter and Police Officer.
Birth. Born on March 18, 1913 in Singapore of Russian parents
Father & Mother both deceased. Father's occupation -
Hairdresser and Mother's Boarding House Keeper.
Other relatives. One sister, last known in Singapore.
History: Gershekovitch was born in Singapore of Russian
parentage, received his education in Hongkong and Singapore,
completing his schooling in 1930 in Singapore. He left Singapore
in April 1931 for Hongkong, where he was employed as a reporter
of newspapers till 1935 when he went to Swatow to work in a
Shipping concern, Lee Bros. This firm liquidated in 1939 when
the Japanese army took occupation. Gershekovitch then came to
Shanghai in Aug. of that year, 1939. He then was employed with or
one of the local newspapers as a newsreporter for a while, he
joined J.Lee & Co., a shipping concern till his enlistment with
the Shanghai Municipal Police Force on November 11th, 1940. His
record in the Police has been exemplary, however, several
complaints were received for indebtedness, these complaints were
made by various persons including moneylenders. Due to his
nationality termination of services with the Police Force occurred
in December 31st, 1943. He then became associated with persons
suspected of being on intelligence service connected with one per-
son called Pick-novans, Gershkovitch associates at this period
were a Portuguese. F.T.Carneiro, Russian Paul Lojinkoff, unknown
nationality, Arnheim. He then was reported to have left Shanghai
for the Phillipines in June of 1944 with his associates. No
further news was known except for several rumours which
circulated that this group had been executed by USSR Ogpu for
espionage work. Whilst in Shanghai Gershkovitch had a Chinese
paramour.

外事科
1944年12月21日
636
事由：英籍人士莫里斯·格尔什科维奇（Morris Gershkovitch）之履历
日期：1945年1月3日
姓名：莫里斯·格尔什科维奇
国籍：英国臣民（俄罗斯裔）
前住址：福州路185号警察总局。
护照：由新加坡英国当局签发的英国护照，第7694号。
上海俄侨委员会签发的俄侨证，第14957号。
职业：航运职员、记者及警务人员。
出生：1913年3月18日出生于新加坡，父母均为俄罗斯人。
父母均已去世。父亲职业为理发师，母亲经营寄宿公寓。
其他亲属：有一姐妹，最后已知住在新加坡。
履历：格尔什科维奇出生于新加坡，父母为俄罗斯人，在香港和新加坡接受教育，1930年在新加坡完成学业。1931年4月他离开新加坡前往香港，在那里担任报社记者直至1935年，随后前往汕头在一家名为“李氏兄弟”（Lee Bros.）的航运公司工作。该公司于1939年日军占领时清算停业。格尔什科维奇遂于1939年8月来到上海。此后他受雇于当地某家报社担任新闻记者一段时间，之后加入另一家航运公司“J. Lee & Co.”，直至1940年11月11日加入上海公共租界工部局警务处。他在警队期间的表现堪称模范，但曾收到数起关于其债务问题的投诉，投诉人包括放债人在内的各色人等。因其国籍原因，其于1943年12月31日终止了在警队的服务。此后，他与一些涉嫌从事情报工作的人员往来，其中涉及一名名为皮克诺万斯（Pick-novans，音译）的人；格尔什科维奇这一时期的交往对象包括葡萄牙人F.T.卡内罗（F.T. Carneiro）、俄罗斯人保罗·洛金科夫（Paul Lojinkoff）以及国籍不明的阿恩海姆（Arnheim，音译）。据报，他于1944年6月与上述同伙离开上海前往菲律宾。除了一些流传的谣言称该团伙因从事间谍活动被苏联国家政治保卫总局（Ogpu）处决外，再无其他消息。在上海期间，格尔什科维奇有一名中国情妇。
